displayName: [Preview]: IoT Hub Device Provisioning Service linked IoT Hub locations should use allowed locations
description: Restrict the locations of IoT hubs linked to Azure IoT Hub Device Provisioning Service to approved regions to meet data residency and sovereignty requirements. This policy evaluates linked IoT Hub allocation destinations and does not evaluate the provisioning service's primary location.

metadata.description: The list of locations where IoT hubs linked to Device Provisioning Service are allowed.
Enable or disable the execution of the policy
